title: Eala makes fast start as weather and transport woes hit Asian Games
summary: Philippines tennis trailblazer Alexandra Eala was in a ruthless mood at the Asian Games on Monday as rain disrupted some events and Japanese organizers faced renewed accusations of mismanagement.
